note: Hand-maintained from the official deprecation pages. Re-check before each release. Entries with a 'kind' other than text are scanned and reported but never drift-tested. gpt-4-1106-preview is listed on OpenAI's page under both 2026-03-26 and 2026-10-23; the later date is used so builds are not failed on a conflicting record. Entries with routes: true keep answering after the date, but the provider sends the requests to the replacement model (Google calls this automatic routing); the 'retires' date is the day routing starts. gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-3.7-flash already route to newer models with no date given, so they are left out. gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview was removed on 2026-11-14: Google now lists it with no shutdown date.
